title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter doc:20260922-70740-P18.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We offer you a firm volume commitment of 23,700 kg a year over 24 or 36 months, which secures your planning. Please see the attached term sheets.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Acknowledging the recent decreases in AS-14404 and PPI-C2431, we have reduced our price to €5.30 per unit.

We appreciate your firm volume commitment of 23,700 kg and are pleased to offer a 24-month contract. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

For an extended 24-month term, we must include an AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot fix prices over this duration. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Our Angebot features a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part:370010 - revised term sheet, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for checking our data and for your revised offer.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

On volume: our attached term sheet binds 23,700 kg per year over 24 months, with payment at 60 days. A fixed price without an adjustment clause gives both sides a stable planning basis and saves you the monthly index administration.

We would also welcome any cheaper variant you can suggest, for example in delivery batch sizes.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 - revised term sheet, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As a fixed price over 24 months is not feasible for us, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause. We have reduced our price to €5.20 per unit, and our colleagues will evaluate potential savings through adjusted delivery batch sizes.

Our adjusted Angebot provides a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.20 per unit. As an option, another package offers a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.subject: Part 370010 - revised term sheet, 24 months fixed price
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for reviewing delivery batch sizes.

We have moved our term sheet a clear step towards you. It keeps the structure of our earlier package: 23,700 kg per year over 24 months, payment at 60 days. A firm price without an adjustment clause spares both teams the monthly index administration and gives you planned volume for two years. Your sales director told us in our meeting (doc:20260916-70740-M5) that Blankstahl Werdenfels focuses on customers with volume.

Your owner offered to walk us through your calculation (doc:20260904-70740-M1). We would gladly take this up if it helps us close the remaining gap.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 - revised term sheet, 24 months fixed price
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and the clear step towards our position. We always value our partnership and love working together with you.

Please note that a fixed price over 24 months is not feasible for us, so we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause; please provide the exact figures regarding the administrative savings you mentioned. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

In response to your movement, we have reduced our price to €5.00 per unit, and our colleagues will contact you to arrange the meeting to discuss our calculation. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit, paired with a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
